prose: Anthropic launched the roadshow for its IPO, offering 825 million Class A shares: 801.4 million from the company and 23.6 million from existing holders, who will keep their proceeds. Underwriters get a 30-day option on 123.75 million more shares. The expected price is $70 to $78 and the stock is applied for on Nasdaq under 'ANT'.
highlights: Nasdaq listing applied for as ANT
